basic_info.description: This charming 9th floor studio is located in the iconic Fontana East building and offers some of the best views in all of San Francisco, including unparalleled views of Alcatraz Island and the Bay. Conveniently located nearby Marina Green, North Beach, Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park and so much more.  Features: 24 hour front-desk doorman & security, deeded parking spot, laundry on each floor, club room, Zen garden with BBQ area. HOA includes electricity, heat, sewer, trash, water, cable, common area maintenance, front doorman, and onsite management.
